tokens.name: cl-cyan
tokens.usage: Raw brand cyan (provided palette). Logo lockup “loom” and the “UI” tag in the dark lockup; build UI on `accent`, not this.

tokens.name: cl-teal
tokens.usage: Raw brand dark teal (provided palette). Wordmark accent and “UI” tag in the light lockup.

tokens.name: cl-graphite
tokens.usage: Raw brand graphite black (provided palette). Logo tile; same value as `gph-900`.

tokens.name: cl-steel
tokens.usage: Raw brand steel gray (provided palette). Logo tile hairline; same value as `gph-700`.

tokens.name: gph-1000
tokens.usage: Deepest void. Behind `surface-inset` (code blocks, input wells) in dark.

tokens.name: gph-950
tokens.usage: App backdrop. Behind `bg-base` in dark.

tokens.name: gph-900
tokens.usage: Graphite base surface. Behind `bg-1` in dark.

tokens.name: gph-850
tokens.usage: Raised surface. Behind `surface-1` in dark.

tokens.name: gph-800
tokens.usage: Card / panel. Behind `surface-2` in dark.

tokens.name: gph-750
tokens.usage: Hover surface. Behind `surface-hover` in dark.

tokens.name: gph-700
tokens.usage: Steel border / divider. Behind `border` in dark.

tokens.name: gph-600
tokens.usage: Heavy divider step. `border-strong` sits lighter (#676e7c) so control outlines reach 3:1.

tokens.name: gph-500
tokens.usage: Disabled fg / faint. Behind `fg-faint` in dark.

tokens.name: gph-400
tokens.usage: Muted fg. Behind `fg-muted` in dark (4.5:1 or more on every dark surface).

tokens.name: gph-300
tokens.usage: Secondary fg. Behind `fg-2` in dark.

tokens.name: gph-200
tokens.usage: High secondary fg. Labels on the darker graphite steps.

tokens.name: gph-100
tokens.usage: Primary fg. Behind `fg-1` in dark.

tokens.name: gph-050
tokens.usage: Near white. Light-theme backdrop tone and the light lockup panel.

tokens.name: cyan-600
tokens.usage: Deep teal, same value as the brand's `cl-teal`. Not used by the semantic tokens since the contrast pass (it reads 4.3:1 under `fg-on-accent`).

tokens.name: cyan-500
tokens.usage: Bright teal. Behind `accent-press` in dark and `accent-hover` in light.

tokens.name: cyan-400
tokens.usage: Primary accent. Behind `accent`, `info` and `border-accent` in dark.

tokens.name: cyan-300
tokens.usage: Hover / glow. Behind `accent-hover` in dark.

tokens.name: cyan-200
tokens.usage: Tint. String literals in code samples on `surface-inset`.

tokens.name: cyan-glow
tokens.usage: Soft cyan aura (0.16 alpha). Decorative glows only — the focus ring is `accent-ring`.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Deepest page backdrop (docs shells, app chrome).

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Default page surface. Ground for `fg-1`, `fg-2`, `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised surface: sticky headers, menus, command palette (at ~80% alpha with blur).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, secondary buttons, neutral badges.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for surfaces, secondary and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Inset wells: inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: fg-1
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `bg-1`, `surface-1`, `surface-2`, `surface-inset` (≥11:1 dark, ≥15:1 light).

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, body copy, labels on `bg-1` and `surface-2` (≥5.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, descriptions, hints and placeholders. 4.5:1 or more on `bg-1`, `surface-1`, `surface-2`, `surface-hover` and `surface-inset` in both themes.

tokens.name: fg-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative marks only (2.1–3.2:1). Never for content that must be read, placeholders included — those use `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: fg-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover` fills (10:1 dark, 6.7:1 on light `accent`, 4.3:1 on light `accent-hover`).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Quietest divider: rows, code-block edges, swatch outlines.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Canonical 1px hairline for cards, inputs, secondary buttons (1.3–1.5:1: decorative, not a control boundary on its own).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines that identify a control: input, select and textarea borders (`border-input`), checkbox and radio rims, handles. 3:1 on `bg-1`, `surface-1`, `surface-2` and `surface-inset` in both themes.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Accent outline for selected or active items.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent: one primary action per view, links, active states, focus. Fill with `fg-on-accent` on top (10.3:1 dark, 5.2:1 light). As a mark it reads 3:1 or more on `bg-1` and `surface-2` in both themes; for small accent text in light use `accent-fg`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of accent buttons. In light it goes one step brighter, which keeps `fg-on-accent` at 6.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of accent buttons: one step deeper than `accent`, still 4.5:1 or more under `fg-on-accent` (6.7:1 dark, 4.6:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent text: eyebrows, links, active nav, accent badges. 10.8:1 on `bg-1` dark; 5.8:1 on `bg-1` light, 4.5:1 or more on every light surface and on `accent-subtle`.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Low-alpha wash for active rows, accent badges, icon tiles, featured cards (≤10%).

tokens.name: accent-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, drawn 3px around focused controls. 3:1 or more against every surface in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11). The softer `cyan-glow` stays for auras, never for focus.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, dots and icons. 4.5:1 or more on its own `success-subtle` fill and on every surface, in both themes. Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill for success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text, dots and icons. 4.5:1 or more on its own `warning-subtle` fill and on every surface, in both themes. Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger text, borders and icons. 4.5:1 or more on its own `danger-subtle` fill and on every surface, in both themes. Success and danger differ mostly by hue — always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill for danger badges and alerts; error-field glow.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info text and icons. Cyan in dark; the deeper `accent-fg` teal in light so it stays readable (5.8:1).

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill for info alerts.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs, drawers and the command palette, with `backdrop-filter: blur(2px)`. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (teal). Categorical slots go in this order, never cycled; validated for color-vision deficiency and ≥3:1 on `bg-1` and `surface-2` in both themes. Line, bar and area fills only — labels stay in `fg-*`. A deeper teal than `accent`, so the cyan stays for actions.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (violet). Categorical slots go in this order, never cycled; validated for color-vision deficiency and ≥3:1 on `bg-1` and `surface-2` in both themes. Line, bar and area fills only — labels stay in `fg-*`.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (orange). Categorical slots go in this order, never cycled; validated for color-vision deficiency and ≥3:1 on `bg-1` and `surface-2` in both themes. Line, bar and area fills only — labels stay in `fg-*`.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (blue). Categorical slots go in this order, never cycled; validated for color-vision deficiency and ≥3:1 on `bg-1` and `surface-2` in both themes. Line, bar and area fills only — labels stay in `fg-*`. Slots 1–3 suffice for scatter, pie and other all-pairs charts; past 3 there, fold into “Other”.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (magenta). Categorical slots go in this order, never cycled; validated for color-vision deficiency and ≥3:1 on `bg-1` and `surface-2` in both themes. Line, bar and area fills only — labels stay in `fg-*`. Slots 1–3 suffice for scatter, pie and other all-pairs charts; past 3 there, fold into “Other”.

families.display: 'Space Grotesk', 'Space Grotesk Variable', 'Geist', 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

tokens.name: text-sm

zIndex.note: One ladder for every layer that floats. Never write a raw z-index; pick the step for the layer's role.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and Select-like lists anchored to a trigger.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and side rails, above page content and open dropdowns.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialog and Drawer, with their scrim.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, including ones opened from inside a dialog.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast notifications, above any open dialog.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips — always the top layer so a hint is never covered.

breakpoint.note: Min-width breakpoints, mobile first — the same values as Tailwind's sm…2xl, so `md:` in components and these tokens always agree. CSS can't read variables in @media: use the Tailwind prefixes in markup and these values in JS (matchMedia) or container queries.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones in landscape: two-column form rows, Pagination labels.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: side-by-side cards, Sheet takes its fixed 400px width.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops: docs layout shows the left nav; app layouts show the fixed sidebar.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: Desktops: docs layout adds the right table-of-contents rail.

tokens.name: breakpoint-2xl
tokens.usage: Wide screens: content stops growing at `container-app`; extra space is margin.

container.note: Max widths for content. Center a block with `mx-auto max-w-(--container-app)` and give it `px-6` (24px) gutters below `md`.

tokens.name: container-prose
tokens.usage: Reading width: docs articles, changelogs, long-form copy (about 70 characters at 15px).

tokens.name: container-app
tokens.usage: App and marketing pages: the outer frame of tables, dashboards and feature grids.
